1: The patient has a history of HBV-positive hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) treated with partial hepatectomy, entecavir, transarterial chemoembolization, sorafenib, regorafenib, and pembrolizumab. The presence of a progressively enlarging, mildly tender right-flank subcutaneous nodule and multiple nodules in liver segments 5 and 7 on abdominal CT suggests extrahepatic metastasis of HCC.
2: Although the patient has a history of HCC, the presence of a subcutaneous mass invading the 12th rib and multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules on imaging studies cannot exclude the possibility of a primary soft tissue sarcoma.
